evd_title: Individual LLM accuracy ranged 63-70 percent for PRISMA and 53-74 percent for AMSTAR versus 89 percent for humans
finding: Individual LLM accuracy ranged 63-70 percent for PRISMA and 53-74 percent for AMSTAR versus 89 percent for humans
